name: Bike Rental Shop
role: You are a bike rental staff.
speaker: Staff

tasks.goal: Greet the staff and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the staff and stated purpose.

Japanese.goal: スタッフにあいさつして用件を伝える
Japanese.hint: 着いたら、まず用件をはっきり伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about daily and hourly bicycle rental rates
tasks.hint: Ask how much renting a bike costs per hour or day.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bike rental rates.

Japanese.goal: 自転車のレンタル料金（1日・1時間あたり）について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 自転車を1時間または1日借りるといくらかかるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Specify bike preference for beach cruiser or mountain bike
tasks.hint: Tell staff what style of bicycle you prefer.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified preferred bicycle type.

Japanese.goal: ビーチクルーザーかマウンテンバイクか、希望の自転車を伝える
Japanese.hint: どんなタイプの自転車がいいか、スタッフに伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Request helmet rental and heavy-duty bike lock key
tasks.hint: Ask for essential safety gear and lock.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested helmet and bike lock.
tasks.scene_hint: Bicycle bells ring as ocean breeze carries sound of distant waves.

Japanese.goal: ヘルメットのレンタルと頑丈な自転車用ロックの鍵を頼む
Japanese.hint: 安全に必要な装備とロックをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for a scenic coastal trail map and route advice
tasks.hint: Inquire where the best bike paths are located.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for bike trail map and recommendations.

Japanese.goal: 景色のいい海沿いのサイクリングコースの地図とルートのアドバイスを頼む
Japanese.hint: 一番いいサイクリングコースがどこにあるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'helmet'
tasks.hint: Helmet is head gear. Ask for a helmet in your size.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'helmet'.

Japanese.goal: 「ヘルメット」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: ヘルメットは頭にかぶる防具です。自分のサイズのヘルメットを頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about child seat attachment for rear bike rack
tasks.hint: Ask if bikes can accommodate young children.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about child bike seat availability.

Japanese.goal: 後ろの荷台に子ども用シートを取り付けられるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 小さい子どもを乗せられる自転車があるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate lower rate for multi-day weekend rental package
tasks.hint: Ask if multi-day rentals come with discount.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated multi-day bike rental discount.

Japanese.goal: 週末の数日間レンタルパックの料金値下げを交渉する
Japanese.hint: 数日間借りると割引があるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask what happens if bicycle suffers flat tire during ride
tasks.hint: Inquire about roadside repair or bike swap policy.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about flat tire or breakdown assistance.

Japanese.goal: 走行中にパンクしたらどうなるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 出先での修理や自転車の交換について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request adjustments to seat height and handlebar position
tasks.hint: Ask staff to adjust bike fit before riding.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested bike seat and handlebar adjustment.
tasks.scene_hint: Racks of shiny colorful bicycles stand outside under palm trees.

Japanese.goal: サドルの高さとハンドルの位置の調整を頼む
Japanese.hint: 乗る前に、体に合うよう自転車を調整してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if electric pedal-assist bikes are available
tasks.hint: Inquire about e-bike rental options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about electric bike availability.

Japanese.goal: 電動アシスト自転車があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 電動自転車のレンタルについて聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm security deposit hold amount on credit card
tasks.hint: Verify deposit terms and release conditions.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed security deposit details.

Japanese.goal: クレジットカードで仮押さえされる保証金の額を確認する
Japanese.hint: 保証金の条件と、いつ返金されるかを確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request printed rental agreement showing return deadline time
tasks.hint: Ask for paper receipt with exact return time.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested rental agreement with return deadline.

Japanese.goal: 返却期限の時刻が書かれたレンタル契約書の印刷を頼む
Japanese.hint: 正確な返却時刻が書かれた紙の控えをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm return location procedure if shop closes early
tasks.hint: Ask where to lock bike if returning after hours.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed after-hours bike return instructions.

Japanese.goal: 店が早く閉まった場合の返却場所と手順を確認する
Japanese.hint: 営業時間後に返す場合、どこに自転車をロックすればいいか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Thank the staff and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the staff AND said goodbye.

Japanese.goal: スタッフにお礼を言って別れのあいさつをする
Japanese.hint: 感謝を伝えて、会話を終えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about bicycle rental availability for afternoon coastal trail rides
tasks.hint: Ask staff what bike models are ready for rental.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about afternoon bike rental availability.

Japanese.goal: 午後の海沿いサイクリング用に借りられる自転車があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: どの車種がすぐに借りられるか、スタッフに聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: State preference for lightweight road bike or electric pedal-assist model
tasks.hint: Inform staff of your preferred bicycle riding style.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated bike style preference.

Japanese.goal: 軽いロードバイクか電動アシスト自転車がいいと伝える
Japanese.hint: 自分の好きな乗り方をスタッフに伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff where the designated bicycle test ride area is located
tasks.hint: Inquire where to try riding bike before signing contract.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bike test ride area location.

Japanese.goal: 試乗エリアがどこにあるかスタッフに尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 契約する前に試し乗りできる場所を聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'kickstand'
tasks.hint: Kickstand holds bike upright when parked. Check if the rental bike has a sturdy kickstand.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'kickstand'.

Japanese.goal: 「スタンド」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: スタンドは止めたときに自転車を立てておくものです。レンタル自転車のスタンドがしっかりしているか確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'maintenance'
tasks.hint: Maintenance refers to routine servicing to keep equipment working properly. Ask if the rental bicycle underwent recent maintenance.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'maintenance'.

Japanese.goal: 「メンテナンス」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: メンテナンスとは、きちんと動くように定期的に手入れをすることです。レンタル自転車が最近メンテナンスされたか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'handbrake'
tasks.hint: Handbrake controls wheel braking on handlebars. Request testing the front and rear handbrakes.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'handbrake'.

Japanese.goal: 「ブレーキ」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: ブレーキはハンドルについていて、車輪を止めるものです。前後のブレーキを試させてもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'punctured'
tasks.hint: Punctured means pierced or flat tire. Ask about procedure if a tire gets punctured on the trail.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'punctured'.

Japanese.goal: 「パンク」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: パンクとはタイヤに穴があいて空気が抜けることです。コースの途中でパンクしたらどうすればいいか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Discuss hydraulic disc brake responsiveness versus traditional rim caliper brakes
tasks.hint: Inquire about stopping power in wet weather conditions.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed hydraulic disc brake performance.

Japanese.goal: 油圧ディスクブレーキと従来のリムブレーキの効き具合の違いについて話す
Japanese.hint: 雨の日の止まりやすさについて聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff to adjust handlebar stem height and saddle tilt angle
tasks.hint: Request custom ergonomic bike fitting adjustments.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested handlebar stem and saddle tilt adjustment.

Japanese.goal: ハンドルのステムの高さとサドルの角度の調整をスタッフに頼む
Japanese.hint: 体に合わせた細かい調整をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Discuss battery range capacity and torque sensors on e-bike pedal assist
tasks.hint: Inquire about watt-hour battery ratings for steep hill climbs.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed e-bike battery range and torque sensors.

Japanese.goal: 電動アシスト自転車のバッテリーの航続距離とトルクセンサーについて話す
Japanese.hint: 急な坂を上るためのバッテリー容量（ワット時）について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about tubeless tire sealant puncture protection versus inner tubes
tasks.hint: Ask staff about tire thorn resistance on gravel trails.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about tubeless tire sealant puncture protection.

Japanese.goal: チューブレスタイヤのシーラントによるパンク防止とチューブ入りタイヤの違いについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 砂利道でトゲが刺さってもパンクしにくいか、スタッフに聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Discuss multi-day touring rental packages including pannier bags and rack mounts
tasks.hint: Inquire about equipping bike for long distance bike-packing.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed multi-day touring bike rental packages.

Japanese.goal: パニアバッグと荷台の取り付けを含む数日間のツーリング用レンタルパックについて話す
Japanese.hint: 長距離の自転車旅行用の装備について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff to inspect chain tension and gear shifting performance
tasks.hint: Inquire about smooth gear shifting across chainrings.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked staff to inspect chain tension and gear shifting.

Japanese.goal: チェーンの張りと変速の具合を点検してほしいとスタッフに頼む
Japanese.hint: 前のギアを切り替えるときに変速がスムーズか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Discuss security lock rating standards hardened steel chain versus U-lock
tasks.hint: Inquire about theft prevention in urban parking areas.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed bicycle security lock ratings and U-locks.

Japanese.goal: ロックの防犯等級について、硬化鋼チェーンとU字ロックを比べて話す
Japanese.hint: 街中の駐輪場での盗難防止について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about roadside breakdown repair dispatch coverage limits
tasks.hint: Ask staff how far out shop mechanics travel for mobile repair.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about mobile bike repair dispatch limits.

Japanese.goal: 出先での故障修理サービスの対応範囲について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 店の整備士がどのくらい遠くまで出張修理に来てくれるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Discuss suspension fork travel pre-load and bounce lockout settings
tasks.hint: Ask staff to adjust front shock absorber stiffness for trail terrain.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed suspension fork lockout and pre-load settings.

Japanese.goal: サスペンションフォークのストローク、プリロード、ロックアウトの設定について話す
Japanese.hint: コースに合わせて前のサスペンションの硬さを調整してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about rental agreement liability waiver terms and collision damage coverage
tasks.hint: Ask staff about financial liability limits for accidental frame damage.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about rental agreement liability waiver terms.

Japanese.goal: レンタル契約の免責条項と衝突による損害の補償について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 事故でフレームを傷つけた場合の負担額の上限を聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff if bike pump gauge checks tire pressure in PSI units
tasks.hint: Inquire about inflating tires to recommended pressure.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about tire pressure gauge readings.
tasks.scene_hint: A floor bike pump with a pressure dial stands beside racks of spare tires.

Japanese.goal: 空気入れのゲージでタイヤの空気圧をPSIで測れるかスタッフに尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 推奨の空気圧までタイヤに空気を入れられるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if padded gel seat covers fit over narrow racing saddles
tasks.hint: Ask staff for cushioned seat pad attachment.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about padded gel seat covers.
tasks.scene_hint: Cushioned gel saddle covers hang on display hooks near the repair counter.

Japanese.goal: 細いレース用サドルにジェル入りサドルカバーがつけられるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: クッション性のあるサドルカバーをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff if water bottle cages are mounted on down tube frames
tasks.hint: Inquire where to secure drinking bottles during ride.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about water bottle frame cages.
tasks.scene_hint: Aluminum water bottle cages screw into threaded frame mounts on rental bikes.

Japanese.goal: ダウンチューブにボトルケージがついているかスタッフに尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 走行中に飲み物のボトルをどこに固定するか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if handlebar bell rings clearly to warn pedestrians on bike path
tasks.hint: Test bike bell chime sound before departure.
tasks.done_when: Learner tested handlebar bell chime sound.
tasks.scene_hint: A small brass handlebar bell chimes brightly when flicked with thumb.

Japanese.goal: サイクリングロードで歩行者に注意できるよう、ハンドルのベルがはっきり鳴るか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 出発前にベルの音を確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff if LED headlight clips onto front handlebars for night riding
tasks.hint: Request rechargeable front light accessory.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested clip-on LED headlight.
tasks.scene_hint: Rechargeable LED bike lights charge in a multi-port USB station on desk.

Japanese.goal: 夜走るためにLEDライトをハンドルの前に取り付けられるかスタッフに尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 充電式のフロントライトをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if rear cargo rack strap bungees hold small daypacks securely
tasks.hint: Ask staff to demonstrate elastic strap attachment.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about rear cargo rack bungee straps.
tasks.scene_hint: Black elastic bungee cords with plastic hooks wrap around rear bike racks.

Japanese.goal: 後ろの荷台のゴムバンドで小さなリュックがしっかり固定できるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ゴムバンドの付け方をスタッフに見せてもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff if printed waterproof trail map marks water refill stations
tasks.hint: Request paper map showing coastal bike path routes.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested waterproof trail route map.
tasks.scene_hint: Laminated bike path maps rest in a wooden stand outside the shop door.

Japanese.goal: 防水のコース地図に給水所が載っているかスタッフに尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 海沿いのサイクリングコースが載った紙の地図をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if child trailer cart connects securely to rear axle hitch
tasks.hint: Ask staff about towing young children behind bike.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about child trailer hitch attachment.
tasks.scene_hint: A yellow two-child bike trailer cart rests parked near the rental fleet.

Japanese.goal: 子ども用トレーラーが後輪の連結部にしっかりつながるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 子どもを乗せて自転車で引っぱることについてスタッフに聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff if tire repair kit includes tire levers and vulcanizing patches
tasks.hint: Inquire about self-service flat fix supplies.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about portable tire repair kit contents.
tasks.scene_hint: Compact saddle bags hold tire levers, patches, and CO2 inflator cartridges.

Japanese.goal: パンク修理キットにタイヤレバーとパッチが入っているかスタッフに尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 自分でパンクを直すための道具について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if shop outdoor wash station rinses beach sand off bicycle chain
tasks.hint: Ask where to spray bike after riding near ocean.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about shop bike washing station.
tasks.scene_hint: A water hose nozzle hangs near a metal wash rack outside shop bay doors.

Japanese.goal: 店の外の洗い場で自転車のチェーンについた砂を洗い流せるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 海の近くを走ったあと、どこで自転車に水をかけられるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff if shiny aluminum bike frames are sanitized after each rental return
tasks.hint: Inquire about bike cleanliness procedures.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bike cleaning and sanitation.
tasks.scene_hint: Spray bottles of frame polish and microfiber cloths sit on workbench.

Japanese.goal: アルミフレームの自転車が返却のたびに消毒されているかスタッフに尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 自転車の清掃の手順について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Respond when staff recommends raising saddle height for proper leg extension
tasks.hint: Permit staff to adjust seat post collar clamp.
tasks.done_when: Learner permitted saddle height adjustment.

Japanese.goal: 足がきちんと伸びるようにサドルを上げることを勧められて、答える
Japanese.hint: スタッフにシートポストのクランプを調整してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify rental duration choice after staff explains hourly versus daily rates
tasks.hint: Select full day rental option for better value.
tasks.done_when: Learner selected full day rental rate option.

Japanese.goal: 時間料金と1日料金の説明を聞いて、レンタル期間を決める
Japanese.hint: お得な1日レンタルを選びましょう。

tasks.goal: Address staff warning that rear brake lever requires firm squeeze
tasks.hint: Test brake lever tension before leaving shop yard.
tasks.done_when: Learner tested brake lever tension.

Japanese.goal: 後ろのブレーキレバーは強く握る必要があるという注意に応じる
Japanese.hint: 店の敷地を出る前に、ブレーキレバーの固さを試しましょう。

tasks.goal: Politely decline staff offer to rent heavy mountain bike for paved beach path
tasks.hint: Reiterate preference for comfortable cruiser bike.
tasks.done_when: Learner declined mountain bike offer for paved trail.

Japanese.goal: 舗装されたビーチの道には重いマウンテンバイクを勧められて、丁寧に断る
Japanese.hint: 乗り心地のいいクルーザーがいいと、もう一度伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Respond to staff inquiry regarding helmet size fit comfort
tasks.hint: Request medium size helmet after trying large size.
tasks.done_when: Learner adjusted helmet size choice.

Japanese.goal: ヘルメットのサイズが合っているか聞かれて答える
Japanese.hint: 大きいサイズを試したあと、ひとつ小さい中サイズのヘルメットをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Address situation where preferred e-bike model battery is uncharged
tasks.hint: Select alternative pedal-assist model with full charge.
tasks.done_when: Learner selected alternative fully-charged e-bike model.

Japanese.goal: 希望の電動自転車のバッテリーが充電されていない状況に対応する
Japanese.hint: 満充電の別の電動アシスト自転車を選びましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify route preference when staff asks if riding on gravel or asphalt
tasks.hint: Confirm riding exclusively on paved coastal bike paths.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified paved trail route preference.

Japanese.goal: 砂利道か舗装路かを聞かれて、走るルートを伝える
Japanese.hint: 舗装された海沿いのサイクリングロードしか走らないと伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Respond when staff demonstrates U-lock key locking mechanism
tasks.hint: Practice locking bike frame and rear wheel to post.
tasks.done_when: Learner practiced operating bike U-lock.

Japanese.goal: U字ロックの鍵のかけ方を見せてもらって、応じる
Japanese.hint: フレームと後輪をポールにつなげてロックする練習をしましょう。

tasks.goal: Address staff request to inspect pre-existing paint scratches on frame
tasks.hint: Acknowledge frame scuffs listed on rental agreement sheet.
tasks.done_when: Learner acknowledged pre-existing frame scratches.

Japanese.goal: フレームの既存の塗装の傷を確認するよう頼まれて、対応する
Japanese.hint: 契約書に記載されたフレームのすり傷を確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify security deposit authorization amount on credit card reader
tasks.hint: Approve hundred-dollar hold on card reader terminal.
tasks.done_when: Learner approved security deposit card hold.

Japanese.goal: カード端末に表示された保証金の仮押さえ額を確認する
Japanese.hint: カード端末で100ドルの仮押さえを承認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Respond to staff question about returning bike after shop closing hours
tasks.hint: Request after-hours lock combination and drop box code.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested after-hours bike return code.

Japanese.goal: 閉店後の自転車の返却について聞かれて答える
Japanese.hint: 営業時間外用のロックの番号と返却ボックスの暗証番号を教えてもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Address staff advice to avoid riding on soft ocean beach sand
tasks.hint: Agree to stay on paved boardwalk trails.
tasks.done_when: Learner agreed to avoid riding on beach sand.

Japanese.goal: 海辺のやわらかい砂の上は走らないようにというアドバイスに応じる
Japanese.hint: 舗装された遊歩道を走ると約束しましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify payment receipt paper copy request at rental counter
tasks.hint: Ask for printed rental receipt with return deadline time.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed rental receipt.

Japanese.goal: レンタルカウンターで支払いの領収書を紙でほしいと伝える
Japanese.hint: 返却期限の時刻が書かれたレンタルの領収書をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm rental shop opening hours for morning bike returns
tasks.hint: Ask staff when shop opens tomorrow.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed morning shop opening hours.

Japanese.goal: 朝に返却するため、店の開店時間を確認する
Japanese.hint: 明日は何時に開くかスタッフに聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff if group rental discounts apply to families renting four bikes
tasks.hint: Inquire about multi-bike rental discount rates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about family group rental discounts.

Japanese.goal: 4台借りる家族にグループ割引があるかスタッフに尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 複数台レンタルの割引料金について聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if helmet rental fee is included in total bike hire price
tasks.hint: Ask staff if safety gear is free with bike.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if helmet rental is included in price.

Japanese.goal: ヘルメットのレンタル料が自転車のレンタル料金に含まれているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 安全装備は自転車とセットで無料か聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request staff to demonstrate gear shifter thumb levers on handlebars
tasks.hint: Ask how to change speeds smoothly while pedaling.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested gear shifter demonstration.

Japanese.goal: ハンドルの変速レバーの使い方を見せてほしいとスタッフに頼む
Japanese.hint: こぎながらスムーズにギアを変える方法を聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff if smartphone handlebar mount holds large screen phones
tasks.hint: Inquire about GPS phone holder attachments.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about phone handlebar mount availability.

Japanese.goal: ハンドルのスマホホルダーに大きい画面のスマホがつけられるかスタッフに尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ナビ用のスマホホルダーについて聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm whether roadside assistance covers flat tire tube replacement on trail
tasks.hint: Ask staff who to call if tire goes flat.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed flat tire roadside assistance policy.

Japanese.goal: コースでパンクしたとき、ロードサービスでチューブ交換をしてもらえるか確認する
Japanese.hint: パンクしたらどこに電話すればいいか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about renting bike storage lock for overnight hotel parking
tasks.hint: Ask staff for heavy duty lock for overnight trip.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about overnight lock rental.

Japanese.goal: ホテルに一晩止めておくための駐輪用ロックを借りられるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 一泊用に頑丈なロックをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about returning rental bike to secondary branch location across town
tasks.hint: Ask staff if one-way rentals are permitted.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about one-way bike rental return options.

Japanese.goal: 町の反対側にある別の店舗に自転車を返せるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 乗り捨てができるかスタッフに聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff for printed rental agreement copy showing security deposit release terms
tasks.hint: Request paper contract copy for records.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed rental agreement contract.

Japanese.goal: 保証金の返金条件が書かれたレンタル契約書の控えを印刷してほしいとスタッフに頼む
Japanese.hint: 保管用に契約書の紙の控えをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm exact deadline return time to avoid late fee penalties
tasks.hint: Ask staff what hour bike must be back.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed exact bike return deadline time.

Japanese.goal: 延滞料金がかからないよう、正確な返却時刻を確認する
Japanese.hint: 何時までに自転車を返せばいいか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Request shop customer service phone number for trail emergency assistance
tasks.hint: Inquire what number to call if lost on trail.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested shop emergency contact phone number.

Japanese.goal: コースで困ったときのために、店の問い合わせ電話番号を教えてもらう
Japanese.hint: コースで道に迷ったらどの番号に電話すればいいか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask staff where to place helmet and key in drop box if shop is closed
tasks.hint: Inquire about after-hours key drop slot location.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about after-hours key drop box location.

Japanese.goal: 店が閉まっていたら、ヘルメットと鍵を返却ボックスのどこに入れればいいかスタッフに尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 営業時間外の鍵の返却口がどこにあるか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Express appreciation to bike shop staff for great gear and trail advice
tasks.hint: Thank staff for friendly service and well-maintained bike.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed appreciation for bike shop service.

Japanese.goal: いい装備とコースのアドバイスについて、スタッフに感謝を伝える
Japanese.hint: 親切な対応と手入れの行き届いた自転車についてお礼を言いましょう。
